## One‑screen plan (green)

```
What we are building: A single‑page static website that shows your dog‑walking
business name, a short description, contact details, and a photo of a happy dog.

Who uses it: Your customers (the public) – no logins, no payments, no sensitive
personal data.
Risk level: Green – no personal data, no money, just a plain site.

Day‑one features:
1. Title & logo (or dog‑postcard image).
2. Short “About us” paragraph.
3. A photo gallery that only shows a few dog photos (public bucket).
4. Contact section: phone / email / simple “Chat” (no form).
   
Information it stores: none (purely static).  
Logins: ❌  
Money: ❌ (you could add a “Book now” link later, but not in v1).  
Built with: a simple static site generator (you can use plain HTML/CSS or a very
lightweight tool like Eleventy or Hugo – no build‑time secrets needed).

Steps:
1. Create an empty folder `dog-walking-site`.
2. Add an `index.html` with the structure above (I’ll give you a starter template).
3. Upload the folder to Netlify (free hosting, no logins required).  
   Netlify will automatically publish the site.

Safety notes:  
• No API keys or secret environment variables.  
• No database – everything is static.  
• No user data or payments – so no extra privacy or security layers needed.  

Not in version one:  
• Booking / calendar  
• Contact form that stores data  
• User logins

Does this look right? Reply **yes** or let me know what you’d like to change.  
Once you say yes, I’ll give you the exact HTML you need and how to deploy it on Netlify.
